# MePersona — The AI Unified Inbox for Content Creators

MePersona is an AI-powered unified inbox for content creators. It brings fan messages from across your platforms into one dashboard and drafts replies in your own voice, so you can keep up genuine fan engagement at scale — without hiring a team or losing what makes you sound like you.

## What is MePersona?

MePersona consolidates fan messages from major creator platforms — including X, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Telegram, Discord, Bluesky, LinkedIn, and Facebook — into a single inbox. You train your persona once, and MePersona drafts voice-matched replies to your fans. Every reply waits for your approval before it's sent. MePersona is fully bilingual, working in both English and Spanish.
